shared_elements: horizontal bands/registers of repeated linear marks or signs
justification: The clearest shared content is only generic: both surfaces include horizontally organized rows of repeated incised marks/signs and some upright forms within a relief-like composition. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by schematic profile animals/birds and geometric motifs, while B is dominated by human/divine figures, flanking relief figures, and a large inscription-like block in a framed monumental scene.
